text: twothetheeexperience. A Gen AI powered celebration and event planner for the Indian market. Budget, timeline, vendor checklists, day-of run-of-show, and personalized ideas. Every number is deterministic. The AI never does arithmetic.

The Hub shows a complete event plan from a single brief. A Punjabi wedding in Jaipur for 350 guests with a 25 lakh rupee budget. The hero card shows the countdown and readiness ring. Three metric tiles summarize budget, guests, and task progress. Active conflicts are flagged below.

The Budget screen breaks down allocations by category. Each line carries a rationale and a source citation with a date. Show the Math reveals the full provenance chain. The invariant verifier at the bottom proves that all lines plus contingency equal the total, with zero tolerance drift.

The Timeline shows the day-of run-of-show at Rambagh Palace, Jaipur. Each item is positioned on a vertical timeline. The Pheras ceremony is pinned to its muhurat window from 4:45 PM to 6 PM. Pinned items cannot be shifted.

The cascade engine is pure graph math, no AI involved. Typing a 20 minute delay and tapping Recalculate shifts all downstream items. Flexible items absorb time by compression. Pinned muhurat windows generate violations instead of moving. Cancel restores the original schedule.

The AI Concierge uses Gemini function calling with deterministic tool calls. Typing a wedding brief triggers extract brief and allocate budget tools. The response includes a budget split, source citations, and next-step questions. Every number traces to a tool result.

Guardrails run on every input and output. A prompt injection attempt is blocked immediately. The guardrail log shows injection scan blocked. A policy violation like suggesting a crash diet is caught and reframed. PII is redacted from logs. Six adversarial tests and nine benign-hard probes are in the eval harness.

The Idea Studio generates fresh, culturally appropriate ideas from the brief context. A Royal Rajasthani theme request produces specific suggestions for a palace courtyard. Changing the input to a minimalist Indo-Japanese fusion gives completely different results. Dynamic output, not hardcoded.

twothetheeexperience. Deterministic planning math for the numbers. Retrieval-grounded AI for the creativity. Guardrails on every surface. An architecture that degrades to a working planner even with the model off. Built for the Indian celebration market.
